zh.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.8 收录上一版本之后的 {{commitCount}} 个提交。

sections.heading: Mobile Companion Host 与远程连接
items: Desktop 恢复由 Platform Account、Personal Pairing 和加密 Relay 组成的 Mobile Companion Host 产品链路，提供远程会话、搜索、历史记录和附件，并对缓存与传输帧设置明确上限。
Desktop 会使用系统代理，并在窗口、Relay 和移动端生命周期变化后可靠恢复连接；Mobile Access、配对和远程故障状态提供可执行的反馈。
Mobile Access 开关在远程 Host 尚未就绪时仍然可见，配对与禁用操作使用单次证明并保持明确的账号权限。

sections.heading: Side Chat 与 Agent
items: Host 重启或 Web origin 变化后，未归档的 Side Chat 会从持久会话恢复标签、历史记录和原模型路由；关闭已发布标签时会先归档，避免下次启动再次出现。
产品分叉会话会清除父会话的目标，支持图片的进程内子 Agent 可以在现有文件读取策略和附件数量限制下接收图片提示。

en.intro: DeepSeek Gestalt 0.1.8 contains the {{commitCount}} commits after the previous Desktop Bundle.

sections.heading: Mobile Companion Host and remote connectivity
items: Desktop restores the Mobile Companion Host product path through Platform Account, Personal Pairing, and the encrypted Relay, including remote sessions, search, history, and attachments with explicit cache and frame limits.
Desktop uses the system proxy and recovers connections across window, Relay, and mobile lifecycle changes. Mobile Access, pairing, and remote failures provide actionable status.
The Mobile Access switch remains visible before the remote Host is ready, and pairing and disable operations use single-use proofs with explicit account authority.

sections.heading: Side Chat and agents
items: After a Host restart or Web origin change, unarchived Side Chats restore their tabs, history, and original model route from durable Sessions. Closing a published tab archives it before local removal so it stays closed after restart.
Product-forked Sessions clear the parent goal, and capable in-process subagents can receive image prompts under the existing file-read policy and attachment limits.
